color_encoding.palette: light blue to cyan blue to dark navy; zero is pale blue and still visible

size_encoding.note: s is the scatter area parameter in pt^2, proportional to geometric circle area; a zero-error observation retains a minimum visible circle

status_handling: All 120 supplied finite observations are rendered as product metrics using quantitative color and area. Original run status remains in plotted_values.tsv and audit.json for provenance.
